intent.raw: Refine the Augmentor ontology consultation API so agents can give deeper beginner-friendly explanations with examples, analogies, storytelling, and a small glossary without overstating current capability.
intent.objective: Produce a validated, implementation-ready, non-executed plan for evidence-bound rich explanation support across the ontology projection, consultation API, answering agent, and API page.
intent.operator_sentence: Make Augmentor consultation answers deeper, clearer, example-rich, analogy-aware, and glossary-supported while preserving current-state truth and owner boundaries.

route_menu.context_hint: Rich explanations can live in projected records, a glossary sidecar plus explanation pack, or final prose generated by the API.

items.label: Enriched records
items.description: Add every explanation field to each projected record; simple lookup but repeated data and coarse reuse.

items.label: Glossary plus explanation pack
items.description: Return bounded explanation support and only the glossary entries used by this answer; selected for reuse, depth, and overhead control.

items.label: API-generated prose
items.description: Let the API write the final response; rejected by default because it collapses evidence retrieval and agent composition.

technique_overlays.trigger: The target needs the complete definition, critique, design, repair, plan, and closeout chain.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every stage consumes named prior evidence and emits a stage artifact or a typed blocked reason.

technique_overlays.trigger: The authored explanation corpus, compiler, neutral projection, API, answer policy, and page divide responsibility across several owners.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The design exposes the authored-to-compiled-to-returned-to-composed field flow.

technique_overlays.trigger: Deeper explanations increase comprehension but can also increase unsupported claims, leakage, and payload cost.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Depth and safety converge on a response-support contract with explicit current-state, example, analogy, glossary, and source boundaries.

technique_overlays.trigger: Three plausible placement strategies must be compared before selecting a contract.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Alternatives A, B, and C have assumptions, elimination conditions, overhead tradeoffs, and a documented winner.

technique_overlays.trigger: Representative questions can expose jargon, overclaim, missing glossary, and misleading analogy defects before implementation.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Five question scenarios specify expected explanation support and fail-closed behavior.

technique_overlays.trigger: Private ontology sources feed a neutral consumer projection, and external research is separately permissioned.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Private fields, public-neutral response support, final prose, and authority remain separate; external research stays blocked without confirmation.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The operator explicitly confirmed three independent read-only lanes for current-state truth, language design, and contract/safety criticism.
subagent_strategy.explanation: The lanes run in parallel over current local evidence. The parent joins all three receipts before authoring the canonical Refine stages and implementation plan.
context: Current-state accuracy must be established before prose design.
Whisper owns meaningful composition guidance but not ontology or API behavior.
The critic attacks leakage, overclaim, glossary drift, misleading examples, and unbounded overhead.
No subagent may write product or run artifacts.

roles.purpose: Verify the current ontology, projection compiler, generated projection, API, answer policy, documentation, and page behavior.
Design the response-support structure, three depth profiles, glossary use, and language auditions.
Attack the explanation contract across leakage, truth, ownership, jargon, examples, analogies, glossary drift, and overhead.
roles.owns: Read-only design-review receipt and change requests.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the confirmed three-lane deep Refine review?

steps.name: Read-only current-state mapper
stop_conditions: block on any attempted write, network access, secret handling, or unverified current-state claim

steps.name: Read-only Whisper explanation designer

capability_metadata.boundary: Meaningful composition guidance only; no API, ontology, or runtime authority.

stop_conditions: block on schema voice, fake certainty, unlabeled illustrative material, or analogy without a limitation

steps.name: Read-only contract and safety critic
stop_conditions: block on writes, external research, credentials, or unsupported fixes

steps.name: Context Builder current-state baseline
stop_conditions: block if current-state capabilities and absent capabilities are not separated

steps.name: Invoke Define rich explanation support
convergence_criteria: The service remains evidence-only while supporting materially deeper agent explanations.
Every explanatory element has a truth, provenance, and ownership boundary.
stop_conditions: block if evidence retrieval and final prose composition collapse into one owner

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
stop_conditions: block if a critical truth, privacy, or ownership ambiguity has no repair route

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: block external research without a named gap and separate operator confirmation

steps.name: Distill explanation-support unit
convergence_criteria: A candidate preserves evidence/prose ownership and the current claim ceiling.
A candidate supports brief, guided, and deep profiles with bounded payload cost.
Rejected candidates have explicit elimination conditions.
stop_conditions: block if the selected unit cannot recompose into a full agent answer

steps.name: Invoke Design projection, API, and agent contract
stop_conditions: block if examples can be mistaken for evidence or analogies omit limitations

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
stop_conditions: block if leakage, prompt injection, cache drift, or unbounded overhead lacks a test

steps.name: Distill Repair with question scenarios
stop_conditions: block if an absent capability can be described as operational

steps.name: Invoke Plan implementation-ready work pack
stop_conditions: block if the first unit is not reversible or exact validation is missing

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: block completion if any stage lacks an artifact or blocked reason

gates.condition: REFINE-DISPATCH.json validates against the live Dispatch Spec schema.
All three confirmed read-only subagents are spawned, joined, closed, and represented by receipts before synthesis.
Any external research requires a named gap and separate operator confirmation.
The run does not mutate product code, deploy, change ontology status or authority state, or turn Inventory and explanation text into behavior authority.
Every response profile separates direct answer, verified current state, illustrative material, analogy limitations, glossary, and boundary/source handles.
The plan names exact files, schemas, tests, task order, measurement targets, stop conditions, and next owner route.

boundaries.contract: Only allowlisted explanation support and source handles may cross; no private authority or secret-bearing fields.
The API returns evidence and explanation support; the agent composes prose without following retrieved instructions.
No external research without a separately confirmed named gap.

promotion_guardrails: A richer explanation is not evidence that the described capability exists.
A glossary is explanatory and non-authoritative.
An illustrative scenario is not source evidence.
This run does not implement, deploy, release, or change authority state.
